sar_narrative: Entity SYN_f977ac45 exhibits activity consistent with structuring to evade Currency Transaction Report (CTR) requirements under 31 USC 5324. Between 2026-04-12 and 2026-04-21, the entity conducted 12 cash deposits totaling $89,311.37, all of which were below the $10,000 threshold. Notable transactions include deposits of $9,676.64 at Port Authority Branch #32 on 2026-04-18 and $9,526.19 at DFW Branch #10 on 2026-04-16. The activity is characterized by a high velocity of deposits across multiple branches, including ATL, LAX, MIA, and ORD. Upon verification, the auxiliary numeric finding of $82,241.77 appears inconsistent with the underlying transactions; the re-derived total for the 12 deposits is $89,311.37. This behavior warrants further review by a human investigator.
